name: shoulder adductor elevator and protractor stretch
description: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
